purpose: Build a development-only expanded Twente training table after the full-duration synchronization audit, without touching historical test subjects.

window_inclusion.rule: Include a window only when mean absolute marker-pose correlation is at least 0.30 and its selected offset is more than 2.5 ms from either scan boundary. This rule was frozen before producing any expanded-model score.

alignment.method: local 10-second marker-pose offset from the frozen synchronization audit
alignment.force_use: Match and label gait events only after the marker-pose offset has been fixed.

deduplication.unit: subject + run + side + force initial-contact event index
deduplication.tie_break: highest synchronization correlation, then smallest absolute candidate-to-force timing error

evaluation.split: subject-disjoint LOSO on development subjects with at least one included stride
evaluation.historical_test_policy: Subj04, Subj11, test2, and test3 are not read, scored, tuned, or retrained on in this experiment.

interpretation_limits: This expansion improves label alignment and sample coverage; it does not by itself prove better deployment performance.
Subj09 has no window passing the frozen synchronization gate and must not be silently included.
Stride count is not an independent-subject count; statistical reporting remains participant-level.
